macos-relocation.note: Needs a macOS host or hosted macOS run that relocates the staged tree, signs nested Mach-O files, and verifies the app with codesign --verify --deep --strict.

clean-vm.note: Needs clean Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu hosts with no preinstalled Python, VapourSynth, FFmpeg, MKVToolNix, or encoders.

installer-sizes.note: Needs compressed and installed sizes for every target and variant, reviewed against the release budget.

uninstall.note: Needs an uninstall check confirming no orphaned helper processes or undocumented user data.

transitive-notices.evidence: Hosted runs 43808022233 and 43822686084 assembled all four target trees against the committed lock. release:audit --tools read each staged tree: 73 Python/plugin packages on Windows and Linux and 74 on each macOS target, with 98 licence texts per target; PYTHON_NOTICES.md and PYTHON-LICENSES.txt were generated for all four targets. The fmetrics fork commit ae87c8e5607063f0dcc8241b52cb143f6c9ad4ac, upstream base e8bf3cfe06fb78f51864804b2f7003667d4c5a71 and recipe digest 5b7b7a8d928a398ff0fbf8856143982b154b56fbffae634b496190fea544fa12 are present in each SOURCE-OFFER.md. The audit checks pass; installer and other readiness gates remain pending.

manual-release-plan.note: Needs the complete manual release test plan with recorded evidence.

updater.note: Stable releases only: provision the minisign key pair and verify a signed n-1 to n update on Windows and Linux.
